description: This file defines an Android activity 'AnimationCloning' demonstrating animation cloning and manipulation with custom view 'MyAnimationView' that animates graphical 'balls' using ObjectAnimator and AnimatorSet, involving cloning animations and creating a bouncing effect.

classes.name: AnimationCloning
classes.description: Main activity class that sets up the user interface and contains inner class for custom drawing and animation.

classes.name: AnimationCloning.MyAnimationView
classes.description: Custom View class that manages animated graphical objects ('balls') and their animations.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, inflates layout, sets up the animation view, and button click listener.

methods.name: createAnimation
methods.description: Creates and clones ObjectAnimator and AnimatorSet objects to animate the 'balls' in the view.

methods.name: addBall
methods.description: Creates a ball shape drawable with a radial gradient, adds it to the list of 'balls', and returns its holder.

methods.name: startAnimation
methods.description: Starts the predefined animation set for the balls.

methods.name: onAnimationUpdate
methods.description: Callback to invalidate the view during each animation frame for redraw.
